name: Putien - Tampines Mall
description: Putien offers a variety of delicious Fujianese dishes, known for their rich flavors and quality ingredients. It’s a great spot for those looking to enjoy a satisfying and authentic Fujianese meal.

items.name: Fresh-baked Yellow Croaker
items.description: Smooth and tender fish baked to perfection with a fresh and flavourful taste.

items.name: Fujian Wild Red Mushroom Chicken Soup
items.description: Steamed for 60 minutes, the wild red mushroom creates a naturally pink, rich and nourishing broth.

items.name: PUTIEN Sweet & Sour pork with Lychees
items.description: A popular traditional Fujian dish - an appetising dish boasting a perfect balance of sourness and sweetness from the real lychees used.

items.name: PUTIEN Crispy Oyster
items.description: This is a must-try Fujian dish! Best paired with PUTIEN special Spice Mum Chilli Sauce!

items.name: Fujian Seafood Lor Mee
items.description: Hearty ingredients and rich broth. A must-order at every table!

items.name: Braised Luffa with Dried Scallop
items.description: The luffa is crisp and tender, the soup is fresh and sweet

items.name: Shredded Pork with Sesame Bun
items.description: Pillowy, golden fried sesame bun is filled with stir-fried shredded lean pork for savoury burst of flavour in every bite.

items.name: Deep-fried Squirrel Yellow Croaker
items.description: Crunchy bite of yellow croaker with juicy and tender meat on the inside, drizzled with sweet and sour sauce with a mildly spicy kick.

items.name: Deep-fried Tenggiri Fish
items.description: Tender fish meat with a crispy finish on the outside, satisfaction in every bite.

items.name: Herbal Prawn
items.description: Sweet and succulent fresh prawns, infused with the light fragrance of nourishing chinese herbs in chinese wine.

items.name: Stir-fried Chilli Clam
items.description: Experience a taste of South East Asia with this home-style stir-fried dish of clams in house-made chilli sauce and spring onions.

items.name: Crispy Butter Prawn
items.description: Buttery and rich, fresh, tender, and juicy.

items.name: Stir-fried Yam
items.description: Crispy brown on the outside, glutinous texture on the inside, enjoy its best tasting moment as soon as it is served!

items.name: Deep Fried Chicken with Garlic
items.description: Evenly marinated chicken that is nicely crisp on the outside and abolutely tender on the inside.

items.name: Deep-fried Pork Trotter with Salt & Pepper
items.description: Cooked to perfection for a tantalizing treat of collagen.

items.name: Crispy Prawn Roll
items.description: Prawn and minced pork rolls deep-fried in a crispy batter.

items.name: PUTIEN Traditional Bean Curd Stew
items.description: Putian's "Filial Piety Soup" is usually the first dish served at banquets, featuring tofu and various delicacies for a fresh and tender taste.

items.name: Braised Duck with Ginger
items.description: Traditionally braised in claypot until duck is charred and fully flavoured. Best paired with ginger slices!

items.name: Claypot Chicken in Fermented Red Rice Wine
items.description: Thoroughly infused in red rice lees then simmered to release its rich bouquet.

items.name: Stone Pot Homemade Bean Curd
items.description: Tofu grilled on hot plate, resulting in a slightly charred exterior yet silky smooth on the inside; best paired with rice!

items.name: Stir-fried Beef
items.description: Tender beef slices wok-seared with chillis for an explosive flavor!

items.name: Stir-fried Spicy Abalone and Pork
items.description: A sizzling favourite!

items.name: Sambal White Water Snowflake
items.description: Crisp and tender with a fragrantly spicy kick.

items.name: Spinach in Superior Stock
items.description: The soft and tender seasonal vegetables are infused with the rich supreme-stock mix of century egg and salted egg to give it a burst of flavour.

items.name: Braised Bean Curd with Chinese Cabbage
items.description: Starring carefully selected yellow core Chinese cabbage and PUTIEN's homemade silky tofu; all simmered in a superior broth for 8 hours.

items.name: Stir-fried Kailan with Bean Curd Skin
items.description: Fragrant, smooth and tasty.

items.name: Deep-fried Eggplant with Pork Floss
items.description: Crunchy and savoury deep-fried eggplant tossed in fragrant pork floss.

items.name: Fujian Red Mushroom Seafood Lor Mee
items.description: A bowl of silky smooth noodles flavoured with 14 fresh ingredients in a rich milky stock.

items.name: Fried Heng Hwa Bee Hoon
items.description: A dish of which its craftsmanship has been listed in the National Intangible Cultural Heritage List. Our specialty-Heng Hwa Bee Hoon-the only sundried vermicelli milled by hand in Putian, is brimming with glutinous fragrance.

items.name: Claypot Cabbage Rice
items.description: Traditional home-style hearty braised rice, suitable for any meal of the day. Cooked with cabbage, braised meat, baby shrimps, mushrooms, clams and scallops.

items.name: Mazu Mee Sua
items.description: Have a bowl of Mazu Mee Sua for a smooth-sailing life.

items.name: First-Harvest Seaweed and Shrimp Fried Rice
items.description: Made with first-harvest seaweed, adding a light, ocean-fresh flavour.

items.name: Salted Yellow Croaker Fish Fried Rice
items.description: Fragrant salted fish gives the rice a rich, savoury kick.

items.name: Brown Sugar Lava Rice Cake
items.description: Sweet Pastries

items.name: Soursop Juice
items.description: Soursop is a tropical fruit originating from Southeast Asia.

items.name: Home-cooked Pearl Barley with Wintermelon
items.description: Freshly made daily.

items.name: WuYi Mountain Da Hong Pao Tea Gift Box
items.description: Selecting only from the core cultivation area in the WuYi Mountain. 10 steps of tea processing, passed down for over 100 years.

items.name: PU TIEN Spice Mum Chilli Sauce
items.description: Three types of finest chilies, added prawn paste flovour and fully cold chain supply.

items.name: Heng Hwa Bee Hoon Gift Box
items.description: The key to delicious bee hoon is in the quality of rice used

items.name: Mazu Mee Sua Gift Box
items.description: Sun-dried all natural mee sua

items.name: First Harvest Seaweed Gift Box
items.description: Finest Seaweed from the first batch of harvest. A better seafood alternative.
